theme_and_mode.rationale: Simple, functional administrative tools and forms perform best with high-contrast light modes to ensure legibility and ease of use in various lighting conditions. Clean and straightforward fits the 'simple' requirement.

rules: Use pure high-contrast text. No gray-on-gray for essential data.
The primary color (Crisp Blue) should only be used for CTAs (Submit, Login) and active states to guide action.
Borders should be crisp and visible.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) for dashboard, flat minimal cards with 1px border and no shadow for the form.
visual_enhancers.radius: sm (0.25rem) or none to give a rigid, functional feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use sharp 1px borders instead of soft shadows. Hover states can have a slight lift with a crisp shadow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in this clinical tool to prevent visual distraction. Solid colors only.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react (Line style, 1.5px stroke weight max for crispness)

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 for form containers and cards. Tailwind standard scale.
layouts_and_spacing.form_layout: Center the attendance form in a clean, narrow container (max-w-md) with ample vertical breathing room (py-20).
layouts_and_spacing.dashboard_layout: Top navigation or sleek sidebar. Main content in a dense grid (gap-6). High Density Grid for data tables.
layouts_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align all form labels, inputs, and tabular data. Optical alignment over geometric.

motion.interactions: Micro-animations only. Translate-y-[-2px] on button hover, sharp color transitions (duration-200 ease-out).
motion.feedback: Use 'sonner' for all success/error toasts with a crisp, bordered aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially placeholder and muted text, meets at least 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a high-contrast focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-attendance', data-testid='login-button').

components.name: Attendance Form
components.instructions: Use Shadcn Form, Input. The date should be a disabled input showing today's date automatically. The photo upload needs a custom styled file input area (dashed border, centered camera icon) strictly with max 5MB validation client-side. No complex gradients, just solid borders.

components.name: Admin Dashboard Table
components.instructions: Use Shadcn Table. Dense, high-density layout. Actions (Edit/Delete/View Photo) should be accessible via an icon button or dropdown menu.

components.name: Admin Recap & Salary
components.instructions: A separate table or view showing Employee Name, Total Days Present, and Calculated Salary (Total Days * Daily Rate). Ensure there is an input to set/edit the 'Daily Rate' globally or per user depending on logic.

components.name: Photo Preview Modal
components.instructions: Use Shadcn Dialog. Clear, large preview of the uploaded photo with a crisp border. No blurry backdrop, use a solid dark overlay (bg-black/80).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize HTML form logic properly with React hook form and Zod validation.
Do NOT add transition: all in CSS. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: background-color 0.2s ease).
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } must be removed from App.css).
Use Lucide-react for all icons (e.g., Camera, User, Calendar, LogOut).
Ensure the photo upload only accepts images (.jpg, .png) and validates the 5MB limit client-side before submission, showing a Sonner toast if it fails.
Implement the 'Gaji per hari' (Salary per day) setting in the admin dashboard so the admin can input a rate and automatically calculate total salary based on total attendance.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use strictly Lucide icons.
Always use a modern button style with a sharp or slightly rounded look (sm radius), with interaction animations (hover:bg-primary/90).
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static is dead.
Avoid generic centered layouts except for the login/attendance standalone wrapper cards.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-8 instead of p-4 on cards) for a premium breathable feel.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Do not use standard alert().
Add fonts via Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.
